notes.title: RATMEN CAMPAIGN UPDATE!!
notes.content:

Right now, around one-third of content is playable and includes a few interesting additions like stealth missions (where your units need to remain undetected), sewers maze and Sorodon's bazaar (with obligatory drunken dwarves fight!).

We have also added a few items which improve the morphed form of heroes, e.g. Spider form of Lexa can be made quite powerful. I hope to add ever more items and work on polymorph mechanics.

We also re-numbered all campaigns as chapters so new players aren't confused about the order of campaigns. For modders - we have modified battle tasks and separate conditions can be made mandatory, e.g. it's possible to force players to open certain Treasure Chest.

Please enjoy and, as always, any feedback is welcome.

Take care,
Les & AOF Team

notes.title: JAVA 17 AND MORE!!
notes.content:
Hello all, I hope you are having a good time. Recently we have been frequently patching all games in the series and it's a good moment to list all changes. Those are substantial chances, therefore please keep reading.


We upgraded to the more recent Java 17 (previously we embedded Java 10 with our games). That gave us access to many new features and optimisations. In our tests, the game engine is working around 40% faster.

Complete attack types are displayed in the lower part of the screen. Our items system often results in layered effects for an attack, for example, a strike could be Fire- and Cold-based (at the same time), could be causing a Stun and also reducing Defence. With this version we display all effects a given attack has.

Open World battles feature a Retreat option where you can abandon battle for a small gold penalty. This feature was requested quite long ago, but we finally got to it.

Fog and Slippery are new battle conditions to be found in Swamps and Winter levels respectively. Fog is reducing the range of projectile-based attacks and spells, Slippery occasionally causes units to slip and lose an action.

Disease was refactored significantly and now infected units will happily spread it around. This is a part of tactics coming in new games in the series.

Polymorph spells and skills are also moving effects to and from morphed units. For example, poisoned Dryad changing into Bear will carry over the poisoned status.

Lamp of Blood (in Krill) campaign is working as a pre-battle action (to be used during Deploy Turn). We hope to add more skills like that which allow players to modify the battlefield before battle.

A few new detector-like skills were added, for example Scan for Guardians. The AI is also more efficient with the use of Invisibility.

Angela received a secret (and very powerful!) weapon. It's hidden in her campaign - who will find it first?


As always, any feedback is welcome!
If there are bugs or issues (especially after Java update), please post them on forums in the bugs-section.

Take care,
Les

notes.title: PUSHING UNITS AND AI HEROES!!
notes.content:
Hi all! Over the last few weeks we have deployed a few new features and other patches, and it's time now to produce a meaningful change log (I am sorry for not being up-to-date with those!).


Pushing units around it the major mechanics we introduced about two weeks ago. Many explosive spells will now move units a bit, just enough to make space for your units to squeeze between and reach those vulnerable shooters and mages. Several units also received Pushing attacks due to their size, e.g. Ogres, Troll Throwers, etc. A few existing skills like Shield Bash or Power Attack are also moving enemy units upon hit.

Knights have now a more effective Greater Charge upgrade where their charges cause more damage (and obviously push enemy units out of the way!). The Charge ability can be disabled for one turn, for example when you want to engage a spellcaster in melee (and block him from using spells).

We have introduced enemy heroes as mini-bosses in campaigns and random battles. So far a few enemy units were considered special thorough campaigns, but those were just like ordinary units with names (and more chatty!). We have upgraded those to hero status (which gives them a few extra Hit Points and several resistances) to give that extra challenge to players.

A dozen new resource items were added, e.g. Fire Opal, Black Gold, Moonstone, etc.


We are also working on several other features, mostly related to Ratmen faction and stealth mechanics; however, those will be available in our new game in the series first.

As usual - please let us know if you spot any bugs. Also, any feedback is welcome!

Take care, Les

notes.title: CRAFTING!!
notes.content:
Hi all, I am proud to announce we finally backported crafting to all our previous games. It took longer than expected, but we are finally there!!

Let me briefly remind you of what crafting feature does:


During battles fallen enemies will generate resource items, for example: Slimes will drop Slime Goo, Wolves will drop Thick Fur, etc.
 
After battle, your units will gather a number of resources from killed enemies, and also resources from the environment, for example Poison Basil can be found on Swamps, while Volcano Crystals can be found on Lava levels.
 
Once an item is seen, your heroes can craft it from resources. However, different artifacts have different requirements of units' attributes, for example to craft Flame Axe you need to have a Blacksmith in your team and also a unit who can deal Fire Damage.
 
Items are grouped into themes, for example all items which have affinity with fire will be grouped into Flame tab. Also, crafting an item from a particular group has a chance of learning other items from the same group!


As you can read above the system is complex, but also very versatile.
As usual - any feedback is welcome.

Edit: Crafting won't be available in Age of Fear: The Undead King due to linearity of game. If you want to use this feature, please upgrade to Gold version of this game.

Take care,
Les & AOF Team

notes.title: SEA PEOPLE!!
notes.content:
Hi all, we have been quiet for a while, however you can be sure we were working hard on the series!

In preparation for the coming release, we have massively updated AOF engine and content. Aside from the promised Invisibility, Traps and Crafting features (which will be available in mainstream games), we have introduced a whole lot of new units, spells and skills.

The below list mentions only the major changes and we leave the rest for you to discover.


Sea People - the whole new faction is being added to the series! Four-arms Nagas, brave Divers, charming Mermaids, weather-changing Sea Witches, giant Sea Snakes, poisonous Sea Snails, etc. As with all other factions, new tactics need to be learned.

Two new units for humans - an Oracle and a flying Griffin Knight. The Oracle is a unit with a unique Clairvoyance skill that helps to see hidden units and traps. The Griffin Knight is an alternative upgrade for a Knight, adding the prized flying ability.

New ray attack mechanic - all units in a line are hit(instead of a single target). For example we upgraded Evil Eyes' Death Ray.

New spells and skills like Silence (temporarily disables enemy spells and skills), Shield Bash (can stun opponent), Riposte (counter-attack after missed strike), Crystal Skin (new trait for Mana addicts), Sharp Senses (to detect traps), Phoenix (restores unit once per battle), etc.

AI-only specialised factions like Spiders, Elementals, Harpies, etc. which randomly appear in locations.

Crafting and resources which let you create almost any item available in game. This feature will only be available for mainstream games in the series.

Invisibility and Traps: Units' actions are hidden from an opponent's view (AI included).This adds a completely new layer to the battles where players need to guess the location of enemies. We also created a set of accompanying skills useful to counter this mechanics. We will release this feature in the coming games in the series.


As always, all feedback is welcome!

Take care and have a good time,
Les & AOF Team

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33896060/be4e325587650e6a7f1d7763e33276231ec1be7c.png
Beastmaster

As tough as a nail, the barbarian princess travels with your party for her own motives. Even the bravest of men should think twice before insulting her as they might end up on the wrong side of her deadly bow. Half-tamed herself, she can speak many beast tongues and sway wild animals to join you.

Hi all,

With this update we are introducing two of the most-awaited features, namely - Beastmaster who can tame wild animals and Chaos Demon faction!

Chaos Demons are known from Age of Fear 2 where a sexy succubus is doing everything in her power to escape her Underworld’s masters. Then she meets a handsome knight Percival… The story is quite pleasing and has a surprising twist, but, like (almost) all stories in the Age of Fear series, ends well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/341150/Age_of_Fear_2_The_Chaos_Lord_GOLD/

Chaos Demons make up quite a strange faction which heavily relies on powerful Summoners and Chaos magic. The majority of its units are Fire-resistant and Evil-bound (as you will expect from Demons!), as such, you will need to find innovative ways to mix other factions’ units to this army. Chaos Demons also offer a number of very-Demonic skills such as Sacrifice, Domination and Unholy Strength spells as well as their own collection of specialized items.


NEW: Golden Clover is a new Relic which will help you getting gold a bit faster.

BALANCE: A number of balance tweaks were applied to Chaos Demons and Greenskins factions - we haven’t finished with neither of them and it deserves it’s own post.

UPDATE: Chain spells and skills target only units in range. This change was introduced to balance powerful spells like Chain Lightning.

UPDATE: Dark Castle Quest, Well of Souls, etc. - sacrificed unit is now selectable. This has been achieved by new script commands (’select-unit-manual’ command) therefore expect more of this functionality.

UPDATE: New icons for Dwarven Runes and a few other other enhanced ones, for example: Scavenger and Warboss.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33896060/caa722ab568fe3f5984b99633e63ac94b6a671ab.png

UPDATE: Refactoring localization - about half a year ago we started recoding our engine to support different languages. Over the last weekend we finally implemented all elements: UI, attributes, conversations, messages, levels, selection dialogs, and so on. We already have a French mod and Japanese in the making 

UPDATE: World Map triggers are executed in parallel (previously in sequence). This optimisation should speed up loading up of World Map and Global Events.

UPDATE: AI optimizations - we have added a number of routines, mostly to support Invisibility feature. That slowed down AI and we had to refactor portions of the code to optimise for that. However, those chances result in overall performance improvement.

BUGFIX: Vanishing units from Reserve.

BUGFIX: Quicksilver Armour was applied after vulnerabilities / resistances.

BUGFIX: Un-equipping Djinn’s Lamp was not removing additional items.

BUGFIX: Global Events were not triggered if any script was broken.

BUGFIX: Counter-damage from Reflection Shield was not always working.

BUGFIX: Heat Ray was not exploding barrels.

BUGFIX: Berserker should not attack static objects anymore.


We are also working on a number of other features such as Desertion, localisations, better balance for Greenskins, and bringing Workshop Manager to the Age of Fear: The Free World. Please also bookmark in your calendars the release of Age of Fear: The Undead King Gold (June/July 2019):

https://store.steampowered.com/app/832770/Age_of_Fear_The_Undead_King_GOLD/

Hi all,

Over the last few weeks we have been busy with adding new features and content, balancing factions, fixing bugs, and so on.

The pressure is high and our players-base greatly expanded - currently the Age of Fear: The Free World has OVER 31,000 DOWNLOADS!!


NEW: Bard - few weeks ago a player suggested another unit with musical skills and here we finally have one ready. The Bard is an all-around unit: a bit of magic, above-average battle stats and, of course, songs! The Bard comes with his own side-quest!

NEW: Reflection Shield - an upgrade for Mages and Archmages. Deflected melee strikes have a chance to damage attacker.

UPDATE: expanded Team Morale explanation in Tutorial. It’s quite a complex feature, therefore more detailed text was needed.

UPDATE: Very Happy Team Morale provides 15% experience bonus.

UPDATE: Djinn and Bard’s voices.

UPDATE: Dwarven Canon is being re-balanced with cooldown mechanics.

UPDATE: New icons for a number of attributes, for example: weapon and armour upgrades, Poison/Acid Cloud, Acid Splash, etc.

UPDATE: OpenAL sound engine has been updated to version 1.1.

BUGFIX: Auto-triggerable attributes were limited to one, now they are run in sequence.

BUGFIX: Unusable items were equipped when stolen, for example Noble Cloak.

BUGFIX: Totem descriptions were updated to correctly reflect their features.


There is also a long list of ongoing features which we are working on and are planned to be released later:


ONGOING: The Undead King Gold is a greatly expanded version of the series' very first entry, a game originally released seven years ago. This project aims to bring Age of Fear series into Open World theme! The work has entered the Beta-test phase and we plan a release for early June 2019.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/832770/Age_of_Fear_The_Undead_King_GOLD/

ONGOING: The Free World Workshop Manager - following the success of the Age of Fear: The Free World, we plan to backport the Workshop Manager into this product as well. It requires some preparatory work and we plan it for mid-2019.

ONGOING: The Free World Extension - we are currently editing campaigns for the remaining factions (Dwarves, Chaos Demons and Forest Folk). The extension release will be synchronised with Workshop Manager.

ONGOING: Desertion - discontent units will attempt to desert.

ONGOING: Taming Beasts - we are still working on Taming skill, allowing you to capture Beast units. Along with the Demons Pact released recently, one will be able to capture all unit types soon.

ONGOING: The Strategy Guide Extension - currently the Strategy Guide lists the first three factions, but we are currently writing on other factions as well. We should be ready with an updated document mid-March.

ONGOING: The Global Events Extension - we have 40+ additional Global Events scheduled and being worked on. Those events will introduce side-quests.

ONGOING: Faction Bases which can be upgraded as you explore the Age of Fear world. Investing in base upgrades will unlock additional recruitable units, skills and locations to explore! This feature will be released first in The Undead King Gold and then we will add it to other games in the series.

ONGOING: Invisibility mechanics are already coded in, but require more testing to make AI aware of this feature. Invisibility will add an element of surprise to battles and mess up your tactics! Prepare for the unexpected!

ONGOING: Unit Voices are currently being re-recorded. There are 80+ voice-bundles and we have about 30% ready. ETA for this update is mid-2019 and hopefully this improvement will be well received!

ONGOING: Localization is coming too! We have started with French (thanks to targus929!), but once this update is stable we will look into other languages.

ONGOING: Desert Battles - we have already drawn a number of new terrains and themed objects like Giant Scorpion, Djinn, Cactuses, etc. Those will be added to existing environments.

ONGOING: The Age of Fear 4 - the main story is already written and we are working on scripts and game flows. The release is planned for 2020 and we will surely push out more news before that.

notes.title: 17,000 DOWNLOADS!! (UPDATE v5.6.6)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/b714e492ba2ad9a927c45c3007ddb1d01ce88137.png
Mephistopheles

Hello, 

I am pleased to announce that we currently have over 17,000 downloads and around 100 concurrent users (peak 137 users). That is AN ASTOUNDING ACHIEVEMENT - The Age of Fear: Free World is still going very strong!

Over the last two weeks, we have applied a number of patches and improvements which are detailed below:


NEW: Demon Pact - we have introduced a way to recruit demons! (aside from paying them thousands of gold). You heroes (but non-Holy ones only!) will have the opportunity to meet Mephistopheles himself and sign a Demon Pact...But what’s the price?

NEW: Dominate Mind - an interesting addition to demonic magic available exclusively to the Demon Mistress. This spell works in a similar way as Time-Shift - it grants a selected unit an extra turn, but in exchange said unit is damaged. However, unlike Time Shift, it can be casted multiple times on a given unit.

NEW: Djinn’s unit - the Djinn’s Lamp quest has been expended and the Djinn himself can now join you! Will you release the poor creature from its golden prison?

NEW: Skeletal Beast - this has been promised a few months ago and during the last weekend we received the completed graphic assets. The Raise Dead spell will raise this fast unit from dead animals like Wolves, Spiders and Rats.

UPDATE: Wave icons - we have replaced another set of icons, for example here are new waves: 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33896060/aa8c8b2faecee39b8fa945be092691120b32c020.png

UPDATE: Team Size - when starting a random battle, the dialog specifies how many units will be deployed. Please note that units can be exchanged with reserve in the first turn (same as items).

UPDATE: AI performance optimisations - it was highlighted several times that the AI is sometimes slowing down. This is the result of all the new mechanics and spells we have added - The AI is evaluating all tactical options available before deciding what to do next and this is computation-intensive. To counter that we optimised and refactored many helper methods and achieved ca. 30-40% speed up in those calculations.

UPDATE: Raise Dead spell was nerfed a bit - raised units now have their corpse upgrade level minus one.

NEW ITEMS: a few more treasures and other items have been added for variety: Sapphire, Sea Shell, Black Pearl, Ring of Poison Resistance, etc.

UPDATE: Transmutter Laboratory now also upgrades Sea Shells to Pearls. The upgrade price has been raised to 2,000 gp.

UPDATE: Units in Nairi's campaign cost gold. Campaign has been updated as well to include gold prizes.

UPDATE: Troll Throwers can now use melee weapons.

BUGFIX: occasionally unit xml files were not loaded correctly and this was crashing the editor. Those were the remains of localisation-related code refactoring and should be fixed now.

BUGFIX: Fallen Knight Hero was not initially upgraded to Black Knight. We have fixed it and introduced a routine to backwardly update all Knights.

BUGFIX: A number of bugs related to Coward, Demon Heart, Survivor, Battle Forged have been fixed- those can be actioned outside battles and it was causing bugs.


Also, we have a first player who spent more than hundred hours in Age of Fear: The Free World - Lachanche! Congratulations!

We have received lots of valuable feedback and suggestions - thank you all for your input! It's great to have such active and grateful Community!

notes.title: GLOBAL EVENTS (WE NEED HELP!!)
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We are working on a "Global Events" feature which will animate the World Map and add some flavour to AOF series. Those are fired semi-randomly while player is accessing World Map. Those are short dialogues or even shorter event image and a note.

Global Events are fired semi-randomly while players are accessing the World Map.

Global Events have a dual purpose of introducing lore and soft-balancing game. Those are short dialogues or even shorter event image and a note:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/b08b5f10996ccb4e79965008816a2bf12d600aad.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/f439555820afd58c42ab0c3de797a4ceb783e992.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/e41c8279cb8a2d737e2a91a3f7ddf944ea64c5d1.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/465f7471a68717446c811863add475bdc56e9c2c.jpg


We already have 40 of them and more are in progress. This feature will be a part of Open World where player can freely roam AOF world.

However, I would ask for your help if could you please help us to create more of Global Events?

Our scripting engine allows for some variety in checking for conditions:

if a given unit’s type exists in the player’s team and also gives count, for example if there are more than two Black Knights in the player’s team
If a given unit’s race exists in the player’s team, for example if there are more than five goblins in the player’s team
Checks for owned items (and counts)
Checks for gold amounts owned by the party
Conditions can be combined
There are many other possible checks - see Modding Guide in Steam Workshop for more details


Additionally Global Events support optional executions-limit which limits total times a given event is triggered. So you can decide if an event is a one time thing or a recurrent one.

The results of such events don’t have to be impactful and can just introduce lore. Some examples:

A comet has flown by (nothing happens)
One of the party goblins was cheating in  a dice game and the other goblins beat him up (permanent wound for one Goblin and -100 gold)
Dwarf rouge shares his the stolen good profit (+200 gold)
The party's Necromancer gets annoyed by the monk’s daily prayers and beats him up (monk gets permanent wound)


We already have 40 of them and more are in progress. However, you are very welcome to share any ideas you might have.

The examples are in files there:
http://age-of-fear.net/downloads/shared-globalevents.xml

However, you don't need to code, just sharing ideas in this post in enough:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/431700/discussions/0/1694917906662452856/

Please just describe in few words what do you have in mind and I will be hopefully able to code that in.


Have a nice weekend,
Les & AOF Team

notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/791580
Its thick fur glistening in the moonlight, the great wolf charges through the forest as a hunting party gives chase with torches lit and weapons drawn. Dodging an arrow, the wolf leaps over a fallen tree and tumbles into a wide clearing. With the soldiers now emerging from the darkness and closing in fast, the wolf bristles, stands on its hind legs and bears its teeth, ready to fight for its life. This is no ordinary canine...

Poor hunters will inevitably learn that forest in not their friend in the dark. Will you brave the dangers of Silent Forest and be lucky enough to come out in one piece?

New hero Gunther - a powerful Werewolf warrior who can turn its enemies into a gang of Werewolves!
Solve the mystery of the murder of Gunther's wife and rescue his daughter Angela!
Five new battles and skirmishes with hunters!
Four new battle music themes!
New enemies - Cyclopes and Nagas!


Personally, I like it very much. Seriously!
It's rare that all things came together so nicely: story, new mechanics, heroes, enemies, etc. Plus it was good motivation to improve a few things in our engine.

As always, please share your feedback!

All of best,
Les & AOF Team

HAPPY X-MAS!! In this patch there are quite several changes and improvements:


new: special locations - we have added a few special locations to both campaigns. Those are shared between campaigns (with minor differences) and will further enrich story and introduce some lore:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/a44eadecc5e366fb56e614a2b8b0dd0a0fbc74d7.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/44a3f6e088f4afc55ea411e6105b068f34e3338c.png
Fountain of Happiness (destroyed/rebuilt)
More will follow! Some locations are timed, i.e. will activate only once during day.

World Map has been back-ported to AOF2. The locations are grayscale, but we are working on that:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/90ff8deb38e901bd104111be62bdfd28a403bd9c.png

new: Entangling Attack - for Ents and Saprolling, attacked enemy won’t be able to move till the next turn. Every attack (failed or succeed) triggers this ability, thus forest faction has a perfect blocker now.

new: Click on items will display item’s detailed description, where temporary attributes are listed.

new: Before evolving unit, player is shown detailed upgrade result:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/f30f30427f3b9a58770a18e38bf1b48c34402003.jpg

new: Bribe skill for Dwarves - similar to Balvar, your dwarf hero will be able to add enemy units to army. Few funny conversations added too after bribing :-)

update: certain races won’t get certain permanent wounds that would not make sense, e.g. blinded skeletons, crippled slime.

update: logging library was slowing down game engine and has been updated.

balance: captured (controlled, bribed, enslaved, etc.) units will retain their upgrade level and will get back 25% of experience from all other attributes. This gives about half total experience from captured units and allows player to select which upgrades to apply. It hopefully won’t break balance.

balance: golems have now lowered resistance to non-physical attacks. They are still very tanky vs normal melee, but fireballs/lightnings/magic will connect much better.

balance: Cave Mushroom and Mana Shard are not counted towards potions limit.

balance: Infravision gives +1 Attack in Darkness.

balance: Hellbat has 2 hp, fire resistance and Segmented Move.

bugfix: various fixes for handling mouse clicks, click boxes, sensitivity, etc. Jeez, the variety of mouse-like devices is surprisingly huge!

bugfix: temporary removing units could duplicate items they were carrying (only with using items on all units enabled in Experimental options).

bugfix: Dryad can wear Phasing Cape and Crystal Armour.

bugfix: AI handles chill touch spell correctly.

other: dwarves campaign voiceover is being done. You can check sample here:
http://age-of-fear.net/downloads/dwarvescampaign-voiceover-spec.wav

other: will all the changes being done and other improvements, I am thinking of pushing price up a bit for AOF series. It will help us to deliver better quality graphics and voiceovers. It’s not definite yet - just giving you heads up.


Take care and have happy X-Mas!
Les

notes.title: WARBANNERS RELEASE 18TH OCTOBER!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/650440/Warbanners/


Hi all,

I would like to point you all towards another TBS game just being released in few days. I know the author for a couple of years and we both have been exchanging design ideas for our games.

Here goes official info:
Crasleen Games, creators of enjoyable fantasy games with deep tactical combat including Drums of War, have announced Warbanners will release for Windows PC and Linux October 18th on Steam.

Warbanners is an indie, meticulously designed, turn-based, tactical strategy game with role-playing elements. Manage a squad of mercenaries, experience a campaign of 42 missions, and strategically fight towards becoming a legend equal to the ancient ones. Master a multi-faceted battle system, and learn how to exploit everything from the terrain to your special units in your road to victory.

Features:

Create a unique army: hire and equip soldiers, develop their fighting qualities, and learn new skills.
Hire assistants: although they do not participate in battles, assistants give different bonuses, including a formidable catapult, poisoning enemies, increasing morale, and much more.
Immerse yourself in a multi-faceted battle system that takes into account a variety of factors, including landscape and lighting, the direction of the unit’s gaze, morale, and fatigue.
Use the environment for tactical purposes: freeze rivers, chop and burn trees, dig trenches, build bridges and barricades, and so on.
Choose the optimal level of difficulty: from easy for beginners, to nightmarish for sophisticated tacticians.


With every step marked by blood and iron, an invisible but deadly threat becomes more tangible. Darkness, brooding in the corners of the soul, becomes ever more palpable….


I reaaaaaaally suggest to check it out!!


Have a nice weekend,
Les

notes.title: UPDATE RELEASED (v4.9.8)!!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/ae83b3bcf230e3960d6f8e6b66a1c3aa97b839e6.png

Welcome to the first major patch after AOF3 release. I am sorry for furious patching in the last couple of weeks, we have been fixing lots of issues and bugs. Everything went rather well and there was no game-breaking bugs :-)

Thanks for all bug-reports, I am working on them!
Below it a list of updates:


DLC: The Elementalist. in case someone missed it:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/688460/

new: (AOF3 only) racial animosity morale bonuses/penalties - it’s a bit experimental still and we are still looking for feedback. The idea is to add some Morale bonuses deposing on your team composition - a detailed info in available in shop’s help.
Hopefully, it will work much better when we finally ready with Open World.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/ede2f3a79819644a67d1c2364eb6985df79743ba.png

new: we have added ca. 20 new static objects: statues, torches, chairs, tables, etc. Thanks to Sergey (our taster), Dwarves campaign has been updated already, but we are still working on forest campaign. Next thing will be to add light effect to torches, so they can be destroyed together. Maybe also some ranged attack bonuses if target is near light source - if that works well and doesn’t confuse players. Units can stand below torches - I hope this will work ok.

new: items can be exchanged during battle's deploy turn. This was introduced to avoid issues, when your hero is ill-equipeed for a particular battle:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/431700/discussions/0/1519260397790242446/
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29835434/ba975999eae964032c3cfc6b28fe90dcf79a775a.png
I also hope it will encourage players to carry huge medicine cabinet and assign potions to units accordingly just before battle :-)

new: dynamic difficulty - we have implemented a convoluted algorithm that detects if you are ahead of difficulty curve at a given level and increases (but never decreases!) relative difficulty. This has been deployed in AOF1 and partially in AOF3.

new items: Swamp Berries - the only item that makes you permanently drunk :-)

update: terrain animations were disabled - they were causing performance drop on some machines. We will re-enable them as soon as issues are resolved.

update: embedded Java has been updated to 9 (only 64-bit systems)

balance: Amulet of Chaos: +3 base MP, No Magic Regeneration, Magic Resistance, 600gp (Rare)

balance: (for Russian players only) default difficulty is Experienced. You guys are gluttons for punishment - that’s it :-)

balance: higher chance for Permanent Wounds

balance: ghosts can use weapon and shield to allow Krill-Wight to have some gear

bugfix: Heroes cannot have Tough attribute

bugfix: improved detection of 64-bit system in Windows (thanks to Tamaster!)

in progress: dynamic balancing of difficulty curve - it will apply only in scenario when you are ahead of difficulty curve and hopefully will make battles more challenging.



PLEASE LEAVE US REVIEW IF YOU LIKE AOF SERIES!!

Enjoy & take care,
Les

Welcome to GOLD update!!

Why Gold you ask?
Everyone likes Gold, right? Age of Fear 2 is a mature product. All the older art has been replaced and many interesting new features have been introduced over the last two years. Features such as morale, potions, items and more. In this release we have reached an important milestone, where all the assets were made by professionals:

Story voice-overs
Conversations 
New story illustrations


Does this mean game won't be developed further?
Absolutely not! Anyone that's followed our progress for some time knows that we regularly release updates and improvements for the game. We are definitely not stopping that, because it's fun for us too!

Are both Age of Fear games Gold now?
Only Age of Fear 2 has been upgraded. We have updated the voice-overs and conversations in Age of Fear 1, but there are still illustrations to re-draw. It will get it Gold status eventually, but not right now.

It wouldn’t be possible without our dedicated players!
We hope you like this release. We really do. It was a long way for us to reach this step and thank you all for support and motivation. To compare, this is what Age of Fear looked like in March 2011:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnGI7QtbLYQ
As always, we ask you to spare few seconds and write a review! Reviews help us improve our game and gather more players, what gives us more resources to work on new features!


All of best,

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9162478/20feb12edff67240ea78c6565a429ed6c4b1f48f.png

Ladies and Gentleman, Dwarves and Elves, Orcs and Goblins, Steam Players and other Zombies...

We give you, long awaited, the one and only, The Great…

(fanfare)

WORKSHOP MANAGER!

(fanfare)


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9162478/1486d6bd8d5c492b0e5b38c6b8d409dd4c2c3aaa.png
Ugly design, isn't it?

Age of Fear engine is very flexible, but it’s not so straight-forward to mod. We have created a pdf guide (available via Workshop Manager), but it does not explain all tips and tricks. I guess it will be much easier to analyse what we have already to see what’s available 
- 4 campaigns (soon two more) plus 180+ units is a substantial sample.

Modding definitely requires some basic IT skills like editing xml files and understanding of basic scripting patterns. Some bits like easy, like units’ stats and attributes. Some bits are medium-difficulty, like campaign flow logic. And some are definitely hard and require some work, such as creating new battles (editing existing ones is way more doable).

Ask any questions on forum - I will answer the best I can. 

Please take it easy!
Those are developer tools and not meant to be polished and bugs-free.  Please write some feedback - we will improve Workshop Manager in future. There is an sample:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=898344196



Happy modding,
Les

PS.
ALWAYS have a backup of modified file.

notes.title: Update released (v4.3.1)!
notes.content:
Hi all,


There are some visual improvements and a couple of new features:

update: shop tutorial in presentation dialog
update: permanent wounds can be cured (for 100 gp)
update: Demon's Lover campaign has more gold (6.2k to 8.5k)
update: Deathseeker/Master difficulties differ only in disabled save games and enabled permanent wounds
update: Blinded is -2 Attack and -3 Ranged Attack
update: Enhanced Weapon/Armour upgrades cost gold as well as experience
update: Summoned imps and terrors can break free (no more summons spamming)
bugfix: hidden items are not visibly targetable by area attacks (e.g. Fireball), but will be hit anyway. Once damaged, marker will show

AOF3 is coming all together quite nicely. I have already asked for making video trailer. I am still adding more extra bits, but from our side it's just polishing story, testing and balance only (but it takes more time than you think!)

Valve has updated its shop layout and algorithms, you can read it about there:
http://www.gamasutra.com/view/news/291118/Steam_Discovery_20_analysis_Valve_shares_latest_metrics.php

Consensus between indie devs is that it lowered their sales somewhere around -25% to -30%. However, as so far we haven't been affected by this - I don't really know why. I see two explanations:

AOF series has very supportive community and it's not that dependant on Steam exposure algorithms. Many thanks to all you guys!
Age of Fear is quite unique product even in its own niche. There are only a handful of games with similar and most of them are quite dated and no longer developed.
We have had a couple of new features released over X-Mas period and that's probably shielded us (i.e. keeping game fresh).



Thank you guys and have a nice week!
Les

Over weekend I was tinkering a bit around potions design. It looks like this so far:
- potions are being sold as items in items shop
- every unit can hold one potion only (also non-heroes!)
- potions are single-use, but their effect in immediate
- potions can be used without losing turn (it means you can drink potion and still attack)
- potions are expensive

So far there are four potions:
- Life Potion/Vial of Blood (for Undead) +2 hp
- Antidote Potion removes poison and disease, cheap
- Magic Potion +3 mp, expensive
- Strength Potion +2 Attack for few turns

Potion's design should force them to be used sparingly. It will change dynamics a bit, but it should not require any major re-balancing.

As always - we are open for suggestions.
What do you think?


Les

notes.title: Why it is important to have own IP as indie game developer?
notes.content:
Hi all,


I just thought of sharing something interesting with you all.

Making business as indie developer is and always has been risky. Having your own Intellectual Property is very important.

Recently Fantasy Flight Games have lost their Games Workshop license:
https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/9/9/a-new-path-forward/

They have to remove any Workshop-related products from their catalogue:
- Black Crusade
- Blood Bowl: Team Manager
- Chaos in the Old World
- Chaos Marauders
- Dark Heresy
- Dark Heresy Second Edition
- Deathwatch
- Forbidden Stars
- Fury of Dracula
- Only War
- Relic
- Rogue Trader
- Space Hulk: Death Angel
- Talisman
- Warhammer: Diskwars
- Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay
- Warhammer: Invasion The Card Game
- Warhammer Quest: The Adventure Card Game
- Warhammer 40,000: Conquest
- All Fantasy Flight Supply products showing imagery licensed to Games Workshop

Quite long list, isn't it?

Just imagine how much work went into creating those products...
And now it has all go to waste as Games Workshop could not agree on license (probably wanted more money). Lots of players disappointed too :-(

That signifies importance of owning your own IP and not licensing anything. Some time ago we have been thinking of getting level maps from 3rd party - price was ok, but 2-years license term was a deal-breaker.

After 2 years we would need to pay how much they want (even if game did not make profit by then!) or have to take down AOF. Thus we did them in-house (a bit more expensive and not so detailed, but ours and ours only).


Take care,
Les

P.S.
We are not affiliated with Fantasy Flight Games by any means, but they have a nice game here (no longer supported thought!):

http://store.steampowered.com/app/348400/

notes.title: Please DON'T buy keys from G2A!
notes.content:
Hi all,


IMPORTANT NOTE:
Steam allowed us to disable old batches. Starting from next week we will de-activate all unredeemed keys from old bundles. If is causes pain to someone, please mails us:
support@age-of-fear.net


Yesterday I have spend ca. 5 hrs implementing new spell - Chain Lightning, which will help to make Greenskins more interesting (it's a offensive spell for Warlock). To support reduction in attack and damage at every lightning hop, a large portion of code had to be refactored. Nevertheless, I did it :-)

However, in the morning I saw sales chart again and that make me fell very sad...

You see - over the last couple of weeks, most of players got their AoF Steam key in a way that made 3rd party profit, making money on me and my team back. I will give you bare facts:

- Over last couple of weeks, about 70-80% of Age of Fear games were purchased via G2A for 1-2 USD. We can't really compete with that price unless we do cheap stuff like puzzles.

- When you purchase AoF key on G2A, we get absolutely zero money from that transaction. Moreover, we are losing sales here on Steam!

- Those keys come from 2-years old bundles. Please don't try to convince me that few thousands people have just found found AoF in their old bundles.

- G2A is not authorised seller of Steam keys and those sales are illegal (re-selling Steam keys is illegal). Unfortunately, we practically cannot do anything about it aside of suing G2A (which costs money and takes time!).

- Sending take-down notices to G2A is utterly pointless. They either don't reply at all or make us to waste lot of time proving that key is illegal. Even if they take game listing down, few days after new one appears.

- I have tried to undercut current sellers from G2A by providing super-cheap keys there, but G2A-ranking system prioritizes 100k+ sellers (I wonder where they get all those super-cheap keys from...)

- G2A is very parasitic company. There are many indie developers affected. More details on that topic there:
https://www.reddit.com/r/gaming/comments/4pgszv/g2a_den_of_thieves/
http://tinybuild.com/g2a-sold-450k-worth-of-our-game-keys


Unfortunately, G2A is what is currently killing small indie games. Development of games costs money and how it currently stands here I can barely cover graphics and sound costs.

I have full-time job and I do AoF in my free time as a hobby. However, I have few other interesting projects to work on (e.g. my phd) and gradually will be spending more time on those.

I am so sorry to bring this topic here.


Take care,
Les


P.S. I have asked Steam to invalidate unused keys from previous bundles batches and hopefully they will invalidate them (they might not). Hopefully they do.

notes.title: Age of Fear 3 Progress Status
notes.content:
Hi all,


Over last few weeks we have been progressing with Age of Fear 3: The Legends. There is still lots to do, but I can share what is currently done and what is still in progress:

- As in AOF1 and AOF2, there will be two campaigns: Dwarves and Forest (so-called monsters-campaign - it's not that simple as you think!)

- Generally there is about 30% more content (battles + story) for each campaign in comparison to AOF1/AOF2. We will also have very nice story illustrations for both campaigns.

- There are more RPG elements (advancing your heroes and collecting items) but at the same time there is still very strong tactical element - heroes are not invincible and troops cooperation is essential

- Capturing enemy units seems to be quite fun, thus we added those mechanics to Forest campaign. It's quite balance-challenge and I am very interested how it would play out

- Dwarves campaign is 80% done and it is in playable state (it is currently beta-tested). We still need to balance it more as well as polish story.

- Forest campaign is 50% done, but it's still not it playable state. Levels' graphics have been done, but we are still writing story and placing units.

- There are about 50 new units in various stages of done (portrait, voices, sprites, skills etc.). They still need to be balanced for both single- and multi-player.

- Aside from game there are various activities that needs to be done: setting up Steam page, introduction video, etc.


Looking at speed how we currently progressing we should be able to release sometime in late 2017 (but it's not a promise!).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9162478/81d1e25cf5a8e68a3310fd5a191b2c68b12a1966.png

notes.title: Update released (v3.1.6)!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have received few reports about choppy animations in last patch.
